name: autoscaling-signal-comparison-ramp
description: IO-T009 signal-comparison experiment: a 5-phase open-loop-poisson ramp against a single gateway replica running the exact admission-sane-v1 configuration inferbench's IB-T010 E2 experiment used (-admission-tenant-queue-cap=3 -admission-global-inflight-budget=6 -admission-global-queue-cap=3 -admission-queue-deadline=500ms, mock backend -ttft=80ms -itl=10ms). Phase 3's rate (37.8072 rps) and phase 4's rate (189.0362 rps) are IB-T010 E2's own 'ib-t010-e2-baseline'/'ib-t010-e2-overload' declared offered rates verbatim, reused here so this run's achieved throughput is directly comparable to inferbench's real measured 33.159 rps / 37.925 rps and to fleetlab's FL-T009 fitted 33.159 rps/replica capacity claim (see experiments/autoscaling/report.md). Input/output length distributions also copied from that same workload (uniform, matching the fitted profile's own training data) rather than invented, for the same reason. Phases 1-2 stay well under the known single-replica capacity (quiet/approaching); phase 3 sits at ~1x; phase 4 is a short ~5x severe-overload burst (mirrors fleetlab's e2-admission-sane-v1-5x-scaleout recommendation scenario exactly); phase 5 is a cool-down window to observe scale-in-direction signal behavior.
